articles.title: Harvest Announces ETF Name Change for MSTY:TSX
articles.mainIdea: Harvest Announces ETF Name Change for MSTY:TSX
articles.summary: Business Wire: Harvest Announces ETF Name Change for MSTY:TSX. OAKVILLE, Ontario, January 09, 2026--Harvest Portfolios Group Inc. ("Harvest") is pleased to announce that, effective today, the Harvest MicroStrategy High Income Shares ETF (TSX:MSTY) changed its name to Harvest Strategy Inc. High Income Shares ETF (TSX:MSTY). The trading symbol for the Class A units of MSTY listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (the "TSX") will not change. An application has been submitted to the TSX for the listed Class A units of the ETF to trade under the new name. Related tickers mentioned: MSTY, MSTY.NE, MSTY.TO.
